source.caption: Performance of various model editing methods on LLaMA3 (8B). Results with asterisks in the superscript are from the ZsRE dataset. SST, RTE, and CoLA demonstrate the general capabilities of the post-edited LLMs. The experiments are conducted with 2000 edited samples for sequential editing. Detailed settings {and results} are provided in Section \ref{sec:rq1} {and Table \ref{tab:overall_comp}, respectively}. Best viewed in color.
